verdict.rationale: Cloudflare's first-party agent tooling on Workers documents MCP consumption: the Agents SDK has built-in MCP support, the Think harness lists 'MCP tools' among its built-ins, and the mppx SDK handles agent-side payment retries for MCP tool calls. However, the evidence never explicitly documents how to connect an external MCP server to a Worker or agent and use its tools. Most MCP evidence (the managed server fleet, Code Mode server, building MCP servers) is server-side and does not count toward this client story. Missing for 10: explicit docs on registering or connecting external MCP servers (URL, transport, auth) from a Worker or agent, tool discovery and invocation details, and independent hands-on corroboration of client-side use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Built-ins include "workspace tools (including bash), custom tools, approvals, MCP tools, code execution, browser tools".
Each agent has its own state, storage, and lifecycle — with built-in support for real-time communication, scheduling, AI model calls, MCP, workflows, and more.
The `mppx` SDK handles payment retries for HTTP requests and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool calls.
